audit.why: Even long-range poke at level 1-2, then Xerath's superior Q/W range plus E-stun setups dominate level 3 through first item; Zilean flips it at two-plus items when Chronoshift and stun devalue his immobile ult.

Xerath's level-6 R Rite of the Arcane (130/115/100s) is the biggest lane-wide threat since it roots him for a global barrage; Zilean's spike is two-plus items, where the stun and Chronoshift punish that immobility.

audit.why: The content whys already correctly describe an even level 1-2 poke standoff, Xerath taking over from level 3 through first item on range and his E-into-Q/R setup, and Zilean flipping it at two-plus items via Chronoshift. The full-layer sides and whys were left as a flat template and never updated to match.
